user.title: Connect to Kilowattlas
user.description: Home Assistant will request a linking code from Kilowattlas so you can share your solar production. Press Submit to continue.

link.title: Approve the link
link.description:
Open this page and sign in to approve sharing:

{verification_uri}

Your code: **{user_code}**

When you have approved it on the website, press Submit.

sensor.title: Choose your solar sensor
sensor.description: Select the power sensor that reports your solar production (in W, kW, or MW).

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Kilowattlas. Check your connection and try again.
error.not_approved_yet: The link hasn't been approved yet. Approve it on the website, then press Submit.

abort.expired: The linking code expired. Please start over.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach Kilowattlas. Please start over.
